data.one_liner: Provides a GlossyContainer widget for glass‑morphic UI effects in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: The package offers a GlossyContainer widget that applies blur, opacity, gradients, and optional background images to create a frosted‑glass look. It works on all Flutter platforms and requires only the standard Flutter SDK.
use_when: You need a quick glass‑morphism effect without writing custom shaders
You want a cross‑platform widget that works on mobile, web, and desktop
avoid_when: Performance is critical on low‑end devices
You need highly customized blur or complex visual effects beyond the provided parameters
strengths: Simple API with many visual parameters
Works on all Flutter platforms out of the box
No native setup or permissions required
weaknesses: Limited to a single container widget
Customization is confined to the exposed properties
Potential performance impact due to blur on large areas
